parsed.rationale: The cluster row contains no populated members array and all structural_evidence fields (differing_slots, jaccard, shared_ancestor, shared_field_count) are null. Without concrete field lists or overlap metrics for Announcement.CodingKeys and ShowMarker.CodingKeys, there is no grounded evidence to support a refactor. CodingKeys enums are typically synthesized or tightly coupled to their enclosing Codable type, making cross-type consolidation inappropriate even if overlap existed. Recommending no-action is the safe choice given the absence of evidence.
